description: NFC boundary — INFORMATIVE contrast: an NFC-normalising construction applied to the same input as jcs-n-kat-12 produces a DIFFERENT digest. jcs-n is NOT NFC-normalising; this fixture documents what a buggy or intentionally-normalising profile would compute, so implementations can detect the deviation. Marked must_fail to exclude from the jcs-n pass suite.
note: NFC(U+0041 U+030A) = U+00C5 (LATIN CAPITAL LETTER A WITH RING ABOVE, precomposed). Normalisation changes BOTH the member order AND the byte encoding: jcs-n (no normalisation): U+0041 < U+0042 => decomposed key sorts FIRST => pre_image 7b2241cc8a... (digest 0b985be8...); NFC-normalised: U+00C5 > U+0042 => B sorts FIRST => pre_image 7b2242...c385... (nfc_contrast_digest 54818123...). A profile that normalises MUST declare its normalisation form and the point in the pipeline where it is applied; failing to declare produces a digest context that cannot be deterministically reproduced. Marked must_fail to exclude from the jcs-n pass suite.
